_meta.description: Maps Ellie's fixed DAIC-WOZ protocol tags (e.g. 'easy_sleep (how easy is it ...)') to a PHQ-8 topic, or to CROSS_CUTTING when the tag probes general mood/diagnosis/therapy rather than one specific symptom domain. Built from scripts/build_tag_inventory.py run against data/processed_daic_woz/train ONLY (Plan_Improve.md Sec 5.2 split discipline) — dev/test tags were not used to decide this mapping. Tags that are pure backchannel ('mhm', 'okay_confirm', ...) or unrelated small talk (LA, travel, military, family, career) are intentionally omitted: retrieval falls back to the keyword lexicon (topic_keywords.json) or, for tags omitted here that still touch mood generically, is left to keyword matching so a superficial pleasantry never becomes 'evidence'.
